sections.brief: What the aid is (2016 MOU $3.3bn FMF + $500m missile defence, lump sum, OSP to zero in FY2028, economic aid ended); its weight over time (aid ÷ Israel GDP 12.7% 1985 → 0.6% 2025, book's arithmetic from CRS + World Bank; defence % GDP >20% mid-1980s → 7.8% 2025; aid share of defence 24% 2011 → ~15%); 1985 stabilisation and the $1.5bn grant; what it frees up stated precisely (fungibility, loan-guarantee offsets, ₪22bn contingent income, Gazit's cost, INSS); successor-MOU talks as of Oct 2026. Figures: flow; compare; stats

Why people compare: Senate votes 2024–25, House 422–6 (July 2025), Gallup Feb 2026, Pew May 2026; scale ($3.8bn ≈ 0.05% of FY2025 outlays, ≈$11 per US resident); told vs record on 'US pays for Israel's healthcare' (NHI Law 1995, health tax, 65% public share; US 26.7m uninsured; 1995 economic aid qualification); five comparison rules and coverage (Freedom House 73/81, OPT rated separately; CBS 10.3m); GDP per person 1985–2025 (37% → 67% of US); elections 27 Oct and 3 Nov 2026. Figures: compare (x2)
